At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="Note">The ''[[Agents of Deception]]'' expansion set takes place within the timeframe of ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', which is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].</ref> a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] '''Dark Jedi''' used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force drain/Legends|drain]] [[Living Force/Legends|life-force]] from a [[Human/Legends|Human]]. With flowing [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the humanoid had white skin with burgundy-striped patterns on their face. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] wore black and red [[Armor/Legends|armor]] while attacking the Human.<ref name="FD" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Jedi was pictured on the card "Force Drain" from the ''[[Agents of Deception]]'' expansion set of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''. The set was released in [[2009]],<ref name="FD" /> and the Dark Jedi was drawn by [[Kieran Yanner]].<ref name="Game Interface">[[Sony]] Online Entertainment interface for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''</ref>
